caption: The video captures a still night landscape in which a single leafless tree stands as a dark silhouette on a low, flat horizon ridge. Above it a star-filled sky grades from deep blue at the top to a pale twilight glow directly behind the trunk, while below the ridge a calm water surface mirrors the scene in a vertically flipped reflection. The tree, its bare branches, the horizon line and the star field hold their positions in a steady framing. The only visible motion lies in the water, where a gentle continuous ripple subtly shifts the texture and waviness of the reflected branches. A faint bright glint on the surface just right of the reflection's upper portion drifts and changes intensity marginally as the water moves. This soft shimmering persists, the reflection never settling into a perfectly smooth mirror image. The quiet process of the water disturbing its own reflection carries on.
relations: Gentle water ripples continuously distort the waviness of the reflected tree branches.
A faint surface glint drifts and shifts intensity as the water moves.
Persistent water motion prevents the reflection from settling into a perfectly smooth mirror image.
